data.revised_prompt:
Create a single horizontal 5-frame sprite strip for a digital pet character named tracebun in the jumping animation state. Use a perfectly flat pure magenta background (#FF00FF) edge to edge across the entire canvas. No borders, no dividers, no guide boxes, no labels, no checkerboard, no white, no gray, no off-white anywhere.

Character identity must stay locked to the canonical base pet: a compact observability guardian rabbit with warm brown and cream fur, sturdy chibi proportions, thick dark outline, small floppy ears, calm focused eyes, tiny service badge on the chest, reliable engineer vibe, and the exact same silhouette/palette/design language. Do not redesign the pet; only change the pose for jumping.

Composition: exactly 5 separate animation frames arranged left-to-right in one row, each frame showing the full character centered with safe padding, no cropping, no crossing into adjacent frames, one complete pose per slot. Keep the same size and identity in every frame. Make the animation readable and distinct but subtle: a gentle jump cycle with crouch, launch, midair lift, peak, and landing. Preserve the chest badge and overall body parts; only adjust limbs/ears/body height slightly for the jump motion. Sprite style should be clean, crisp, pixel-art-like but polished, suitable for a game sprite strip.
